name: One or Many
subtitle: Is or are? Swipe it fast
promotionalText: Swipe left for one, right for many. A fast, fun way to make "the cars are" automatic, with streaks, levels, Boss rounds and stats that show what's getting easier.
description:
Is it "the cars is" or "the cars are"? One or Many is a swipe game that makes English singular and plural agreement automatic, so the right word comes out on its own when you're speaking, not just on a worksheet.

How it works
Every card is a sentence with one word missing. Swipe left for the singular form (one) or right for the plural form (many). Right answers score points, and fast right answers score the most: a speed bonus drains while you think, and streaks multiply your points up to ×3.

Learn from every miss
Miss a card and it comes back with the real subject highlighted and a one-line reason, like "The subject is the box, not the chocolates." Then you swipe it the right way, so the last thing your hands do is the correct move. Missed sentences go to the Fix-it pile and come back over the next days until they're right and fast three times in a row.

Eight levels, from easy to tricky
• One or many: the dogs are, my phone is
• The -s flip: she walks, they walk; has and have; was and were
• Irregular plurals: children, people, feet, mice
• Each, every and both: everyone is, both are
• Words in the way: the box of chocolates is
• Uncountables: homework, news, advice, furniture
• There is, there are, and questions
• Tricky ones: my mom and my aunt are, one of my friends is, ten dollars is
Beat four rounds and the level's Boss round to open the next one.

Modes for every day
• Journey: learn new patterns, with stars for each round
• Daily 20: a two-minute daily mission that mixes in the cards you missed
• Shot Clock: every card on a clock that gets faster as you go
• Sprint 60: as many as you can in a minute
• Fix-it: a calm round with just your missed sentences

See the progress
Stats show accuracy and answer time over the weeks, which patterns still need work, your practice streak and how many sentences you've mastered. Scores keep your best Shot Clock and Sprint runs.

For parents and teachers
The Parent corner (behind a PIN) shows the weakest patterns and most-missed sentences, lets you turn topics on or off, and lets you add sentences you heard your child say, so they get practiced too.

No account, no ads, no tracking
Everything stays on the iPhone. The app never connects to the internet and collects no data.
reviewNotes:
One or Many is a single-player practice game. There's no sign-in, no network access and no in-app purchases.

To try it: on the home screen tap Play on Daily 20 (or the orange arrow on the Journey card). Each card is a sentence with a blank; swipe left for the singular form or right for the plural form (the two buttons under the card work too). After a wrong answer, swipe the card the correct way to continue. Shot Clock and Sprint 60 are the timed modes. The round summary's Home button returns to the home screen.

The Parent corner is behind the gear icon on the home screen; the first time, it asks to create any 4-digit PIN. The app stores progress only on the device.
